title: Tuesday Nights Unplugged @ Cedar Street Social
event_description: Free live music jam session where local musicians gather to perform acoustically. Both amateur and professional musicians participate in a relaxed community-centric setting.
event_venue_information:
Cedar Street Social

Cedar Street Social is a hidden gem nestled within the Insider/Outsider collective in downtown Mobile. This intimate venue features exceptional sound quality and a beautifully restored interior with modern design blended with cozy seating. The bar specializes in craft cocktails and local beers.

Tuesday Night Unplugged Sessions

The highlight of Cedar Street Social is its free Tuesday night unplugged music sessions where local musicians of all skill levels gather to perform acoustically. The community-centric vibe fosters a sense of belonging as amateur and professional musicians jam together.

Venue Atmosphere

Located inside the Insider/Outsider collective, this quaint venue may seem hidden but boasts exceptional acoustic excellence with genres ranging from country and folk to indie and southern sounds. Free parking is available behind the venue for guests.

title: Wednesday Open Mic @ Veet's Bar
event_description: Open microphone night featuring blues, rock, country and alternative music. Local talent takes the stage in a historic downtown venue with great drinks and a welcoming atmosphere.
hosts: House band Doug Previto & The Family Jewels
backline: PA system and stage equipment provided
event_venue_information:
Veet's Bar

Veet's Bar has been a fixture in downtown Mobile since February 1998 showcasing live music and creating a home for musicians near and far. Located in a historic building lining the west side of Royal Street on Mobile's main Mardi Gras route.

Open Mic & Live Music

Veet's hosts open mic on Wednesdays along with karaoke on Tuesdays. Thursday nights feature acoustic acts while Fridays and Saturdays showcase full bands. The venue is known for its house band Doug Previto & The Family Jewels who have played as opening acts for top touring acts across the country.

Venue Details

This 200+ capacity venue features a stage with professional sound and lighting. The 21+ bar serves cocktails and has access to neighboring restaurants for food. No cover charge for many nights making it an affordable option for music lovers.

title: Saturday Live Music @ Callaghan's Irish Social Club
event_description: Live performances featuring local legends and touring acts spanning rock, country, folk and alternative genres. Showcasing emerging and established artists in an intimate neighborhood setting.
event_venue_information:
Callaghan's Irish Social Club

Since 1946 Callaghan's Irish Social Club has been a beloved gathering place in Mobile's charming Oakleigh Garden District. Voted America's Best Bar by Esquire Magazine and Best Burger in Alabama by USA Today and Alabama Magazine.

Live Music Heritage

Callaghan's features live music from Wednesday through Sunday nights as well as during brunch on Saturdays and Sundays. The venue has no traditional stage just the edge of a room where both legends and locals perform on the same patch of green-and-white tile just feet from the bar.

Historic Venue & Artists

Known as the venue where artists play just before hitting the big time Callaghan's has hosted Jason Isbell Houndmouth Band of Heathens and The Red Clay Strays who became the biggest band out of Mobile since Wet Willie. After Hurricane Katrina musicians from New Orleans began appearing with Grayson Capps performing regularly on Sundays.
